description: Source code for the VEML7700 ambient light sensor driver in Zephyr RTOS, including configuration, measurement functions, and power management.

methods.name: veml7700_sleep_by_integration_time
methods.description: Waits for a duration based on the sensor's integration time to allow measurement completion.

methods.name: veml7700_counts_to_lux
methods.description: Converts sensor counts to lux using gain and integration time resolution matrix.

methods.name: veml7700_lux_to_counts
methods.description: Converts lux value to sensor counts based on current gain and integration time.

methods.name: veml7700_check_gain
methods.description: Checks if a sensor_value is within valid gain range.

methods.name: veml7700_check_it
methods.description: Checks if a sensor_value is within valid integration time range.

methods.name: veml7700_check_int_mode
methods.description: Checks if a sensor_value is within valid interrupt mode range.

methods.name: veml7700_build_als_conf_param
methods.description: Builds ALS configuration register value from current data settings.

methods.name: veml7700_build_psm_param
methods.description: Builds power saving mode parameter from device configuration.

methods.name: veml7700_write
methods.description: Writes a 16-bit command and data to the sensor via I2C.

methods.name: veml7700_read
methods.description: Reads a 16-bit data value from the sensor via I2C.

methods.name: veml7700_write_als_conf
methods.description: Writes ALS configuration to the sensor.

methods.name: veml7700_write_psm
methods.description: Writes power saving mode configuration.

methods.name: veml7700_write_thresh_low
methods.description: Writes low threshold value.

methods.name: veml7700_write_thresh_high
methods.description: Writes high threshold value.

methods.name: veml7700_set_shutdown_flag
methods.description: Sets the sensor's shutdown flag.

methods.name: veml7700_fetch_als
methods.description: Fetches ALS measurement data.

methods.name: veml7700_fetch_white
methods.description: Fetches white light measurement data.

methods.name: veml7700_fetch_int_flags
methods.description: Fetches interrupt flags.

methods.name: veml7700_attr_set
methods.description: Sets sensor attributes such as thresholds, gain, integration time, and interrupt mode.

methods.name: veml7700_attr_get
methods.description: Gets current sensor attribute values.

methods.name: veml7700_perform_single_measurement
methods.description: Performs a single measurement cycle.

methods.name: veml7700_sample_fetch
methods.description: Fetches sensor data based on the specified channel.

methods.name: veml7700_channel_get
methods.description: Retrieves sensor data for a specific channel.

methods.name: veml7700_pm_action
methods.description: Handles power management suspend/resume actions.

methods.name: veml7700_init
methods.description: Initializes the sensor device, sets default configurations.
